features.title: Fix ruled surface bug for smooth NURBS loft

features.notes: User complained model was not silky smooth. Discovered that Ruled=True was passed to makeLoft, creating flat segments. Changing to False creates a smooth B-Spline interpolation.

features.title: 1600x800x580mm Workstation (V27.0 500mm Column Master Edition: Tabletop at 604mm, 15.88m 4040, Stepless Middle Beams, Dual Drawers & Trays)
features.user_visible_behavior: Parametric FreeCAD script in drawing/src/workbench_500.py generates a 1600x800x580mm heavy workstation (tabletop at 604mm, ultra-ergonomic low sitting station) with symmetrical dual 740mm bays: 500mm upright columns, lower tier with two 700x700mm slide trays directly mounted to boundary Y-beams (left for xTool M2 with 49mm sliding headroom under mid-beam, right for material sheets/stock), first tier with two matching 680x550x160mm 2020 aluminum deep drawers (140mm internal net depth), and tabletop carrying L4 (top 1281mm), Canon MF113w (top 859mm), and P1S+AMS (top 1285mm, chest height) with equal 72mm clearances. Middle 3 Y-beams use 6 anchor pins in column vertical T-slots for stepless manual height adjustment during physical assembly.
